notes.title: The Golden Age
notes.content:
-Golden Marbles now worth 100 points each instead of 10. They also have a slightly lower cool down timer.

This is to make it so golden marbles are always worth it.

Happy Mashing!

(If you notice any bugs or have any suggestion/critiques be sure to reach out to me on the discussion board!)

notes.title: Much Needed Polish!
notes.content:
-Tons of new sprites to make the game look more polished!
-Made the splash screen look more alive.
-Leaderboard got a huge makeover. Global and Friends leaderboards.
-Medals for the top 3 players on the leaderboards!
-Avatar moves when you get combos and talks!
-Game Over Scene got a little bit more love.
-Shop also got some love.

notes.title: More Backgrounds!
notes.content:
-In options you can choose between four background! (Clouds, Water, Fractal, and None)
-Cleaned up the Options menu even more and made the volume tab easier to grab with touchscreen.
-FPS selection is loaded on launch instead of having to go to options every time.

(Fractal background is the best incase you are wondering!)

notes.title: Frames, Options and Credits
notes.content:
-Added an option to switch between 30fps and 60fps in options(I recommend 30fps for Steamdeck)
-Improved Options and Credits menus.

(Don't forget you can always push an update to steam by restarting it.)

notes.title: Upload Score Bug Fix
notes.content:
-Fixed the worst possible bug where your score wouldn't upload to the Leaderboard.

(Thanks Wizard and Leek for reporting the bug to me!)

notes.title: Working towards Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
-Game speed is not based on FPS anymore.
-UI elements scale with screen size.

notes.title: Achievement
notes.content: -Added an Achievement for launching the game!

notes.content:
